findings.message: F-2026-021 medium 6.4: Pair Now's open window lets any LAN or tailnet host pair with this side and then sign peer requests (some of its code has changed)

F-2026-023 medium 6.8: Syncthing API key sent with certificate checks off, and over plain http when the URL says so (some of its code has changed)
F-2026-024 medium 6.8: Plex token sent to every Plex server with TLS certificate and hostname checks off (some of its code has changed)
F-2026-025 hardening, medium: Optimizer container mounts the whole settings folder, including the TrueNAS key and Plex token (some of its code has changed)
F-2026-026 hardening, medium: Unsigned pairing request makes the NAS probe attacker-chosen addresses and ports (some of its code has changed)
F-2026-027 hardening, medium: Unlink's keep check uses 'and', so a different same-size file passes and the path is deleted (some of its code has changed)
F-2026-028 hardening, low: Tool choices can overwrite any row field, including the file paths the tool acts on (some of its code has changed)
F-2026-029 hardening, medium: Image build downloads its tools and ffmpeg without checksums or signatures (some of its code has changed)
F-2026-030 hardening, low: Actions and base images pinned by mutable tag, not digest or commit (some of its code has changed)
F-2026-031 hardening, medium: Basic auth isn't covered by the sign-in lockout, so guessing runs at about one try a second with no limit (some of its code has changed)
F-2026-032 medium 6.8: Plex and mirror tokens are sent over plain http when the address is http:// (some of its code has changed)
F-2026-033 medium 5.9: The MQTT password is sent unencrypted by default, or over TLS with the certificate unchecked (some of its code has changed)
F-2026-034 hardening, low: The optimizer token is sent over plain http when PLEXCACHE_OPTIMIZER_URL points at another host (some of its code has changed)
F-2026-035 medium 6.5: With no sign-in set, a LAN client can repoint TrueNAS, Plex or MQTT and clear the TLS pins, so the saved secret goes to its server
F-2026-036 medium 4.8: Plex and TrueNAS addresses are saved from the request's Host header, so a LAN client can point them at its own server
F-2026-037 hardening, low: The Plex match's public-page URL is shown as a link without a scheme check
